svg.aria-label: Harsha Pilli, Java and Spring Boot developer. Three years of production delivery before the degree, now completing a Master of Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie University in Halifax. Available for a 4 or 8 month developer co-op from January 2027.

g.text: Java · Spring Boot · REST APIs · Cloud
Three years of production delivery before the degree, not after it.
Now completing a Master of Applied Computer Science at Dalhousie
University in Halifax, and looking for a 4- or 8-month developer
